boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 96 is a pure density puzzle — no chambers, no frames, just wall-to-wall colored blocks of varying sizes. A tall red block with counter `12` divides the center like a wall, two large purple blocks (counters `9` and `5`) dominate the right half, and orange/green blocks fill the left. Clear the small counter-`1` edge blocks first for breathing room, unlock the gated green `3` block, then feed the large pieces through their nearest exits.
landmarks: Block Out Level 96 is a pure density puzzle — no chambers, no frames, just wall-to-wall colored blocks of varying sizes.
A tall red block with counter `12` divides the center like a wall, two large purple blocks (counters `9` and `5`) dominate the right half, and orange/green blocks fill the left.
Clear the small counter-`1` edge blocks first for breathing room, unlock the gated green `3` block, then feed the large pieces through their nearest exits.

quickTips: Clear the small counter-`1` edge blocks first — each one creates room for the large blocks to shift.
Unlock the green `3` block early by removing its yellow key — it gates the left-side path.
The tall red `12` block divides the board like a wall — clear both sides of it before starting its feed.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Clear the small counter-`1` blocks around the edges: orange upward (top exit), yellow `1` rightward (right-wall exit), cyan `1` downward (bottom exit) — each creates breathing room (02:54–02:48 in the video).

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Push the yellow key block near the center through the right exit to unlock the gated green `3` block (02:42).

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Begin feeding the upper purple `9` block through the right-wall exit — nine passes (02:42–02:30).

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Clear the unlocked green `3` block through the left-wall exit now that the gate is open (02:30).

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Start feeding the tall red `12` block through the left-wall exit — twelve passes, keeping the left lane clear of debris (02:25–02:13).

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Feed the lower purple `5` block through the lower right-wall exit — five passes (02:13–02:07).

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Clear remaining orange, yellow, and blue blocks through their nearest exits as the board opens (02:07–02:01).

steps.title: Move 8
steps.instruction: Finish with the last small blocks at the bottom once the board is mostly open (01:56).

failurePoints: Starting the tall red `12` block feed before clearing the small debris on the left side — it stalls mid-feed and traps the orange and green blocks behind it.
Ignoring the locked green `3` block's key early on — the key block must exit before the green block can move, and leaving it late creates a bottleneck.
